decision_question.property: Can mutation of exported IR facade maps legitimately change the module/attribute selected by the lazy facade at runtime?
decision_question.choice_required: G should choose whether these exported maps are supported runtime extension points (B), or immutable source manifests whose mutation is unsupported (A). Until selected, the static collector must not promote a mutable map literal as authoritative for the actual runtime import target.
decision_question.A_immutable_source_manifest: Make defining-owner maps immutable before facade import and expose read-only Mapping views. Preserve export names, resolve_lazy_export/lazy_dir/facade_export_names, lazy loading, child-module behavior and namespace memoization. Facades and PACKAGE_FACADE_EXPORTS read the same canonical owner maps. Extend the collector to derive the existing resolver’s actual selection/cache semantics rather than keeping a second interpretation. Do not retain a mutable compatibility dict that silently stops steering imports; if G requires a migration window, specify its behavior and end explicitly.
decision_question.B_supported_mutation: Keep current mutable dict maps and the behavior where mutation before facade import changes the imported object. The source-only collector must produce typed unresolved/not_established for map-derived targets and refuse a positive based on the literal alone. Any later positive needs a separately sourced, current runtime map snapshot/receipt; none is established here.
decision_question.author_recommendation: Prefer A only if G determines external map mutation is not a supported compatibility contract and accepts a documented read-only API migration; otherwise choose B and retain the static refusal. This proposal does not select or execute either choice.

reuse_extend_consolidate_build.reuse: Reuse the existing IR API owner module, LazyExportMap, resolve_lazy_export, lazy_dir, facade_export_names, six PEP-562 facades and maps. The issue is source-map authority, not a missing registry.
reuse_extend_consolidate_build.extend: Under A, extend the existing map type/resolver and derive the collector’s proof from the shared source-owned helper. Under B, extend the collector result vocabulary so map-selected mutable targets remain explicitly not_established.
reuse_extend_consolidate_build.consolidate: Under A, consolidate the four public map views and three private facade tables over one immutable owner definition while preserving PACKAGE_FACADE_EXPORTS/schema catalog agreement. Under B, retain one runtime map contract and make its static limitation explicit instead of duplicating a guessed snapshot.
reuse_extend_consolidate_build.build_new: A new plugin/registration subsystem is not justified; it would not answer whether mutation of today’s exported dict is part of the API contract.
